[Due by **{{< var due.survey >}}**]{.highlight-yellow}

The survey asks what you already do with AI tools, what you want out of the day, and what data you are bringing. It shapes the exercises, so answering it early genuinely changes what happens in the room.

::: {.callout-important}
## Survey link

The survey link goes out by email with the account details described in [Step 4](04-install-claude-code.qmd), and will be added here once it is live.
:::

It takes about ten minutes. Three things it asks that are worth thinking about first:

**Which AI tools do you already use, and how often?** There is no right answer, including "none". The room will hold people who use an agent every day and people who have never opened one, and the exercises are built for both.

**What are you bringing as your dataset?** One sentence about the data from [Step 1](01-bring-your-data.qmd). This tells us whether we need to pair anyone up.

**What do you want to be able to do afterwards?** The most useful answers are specific. "Understand AI better" is hard to build a session around; "know whether I can let an agent near my analysis scripts without losing track of what changed" is a question we can answer in a day.

## {{< fa lock >}} What happens to your answers

Responses are used to plan the workshop and are not shared outside the teaching team. Nothing from the survey goes into a repository or into an AI tool.
